# glinet Provider

Manage Wi-Fi settings and coordinated network, DHCP, firewall and DNS configuration on GL.iNet Flint 2 (GL-MT6000), stock firmware 4.11.0 in router mode over verified SSH.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    glinet = {
      source = "elephant-evergreen/glinet"
    }
  }
}

provider "glinet" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `host` (String) Router hostname or IP address. Falls back to `GLINET_HOST`.
- `known_hosts_file` (String) Path to a known_hosts file containing the verified router host key. Falls back to `GLINET_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE`. Host-key verification is always required.
- `port` (Number) SSH port. Falls back to `GLINET_PORT`, then `22`.
- `private_key_file` (String) Path to an unencrypted OpenSSH private key for root. Falls back to `GLINET_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE`. Key contents are not part of the provider schema.
